# forgebase_service_account (Data Source)

Looks up a service account by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "forgebase_service_account" "ci" {
  name = "ci-deploys"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by internal/docgen; do not edit by hand (run `go generate ./...`) -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service account name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `created_by` (String) Creator.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Disabled.
- `id` (String) Service account id.
- `realm` (String) Realm.
- `role` (String) `service` or `admin`.
